keyFindings: ONSBT has far higher clear-outcome visibility than ONWSIB and WSIAT.
ONSBT shows 98.9% worker success rate from clear outcomes - highest among the compared Ontario tribunals.
ONWSIB internal reviews remain 95.7% unresolved in public records, preventing a reliable system-wide success-rate claim.
Social benefits eligibility determinations are more explicit than workplace injury decisions.
The reconciled ONWSIB archive now aligns fully with observed CanLII browse counts for 2020-2026.
